integrity: Self-contained proof and independently implemented small-case enumeration in the embedded verification program; all evidence files are integral, not external dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the specified alternating pair of connected cubic simple graphs and phase-augmented periods; no classification for arbitrary switched graphs. Finite enumeration is supporting evidence, not the infinite-family proof. External independent audit and exhaustive global novelty certification were not performed.
title: A complete necklace spectrum for majority dynamics on alternating connected cubic graphs
